review_description: I received 3 quotes from M LIA giving me options. I spoke with Vanessa and found her extremely helpful and patient. I was fully informed during the process and it was completed in a very timely manner. Highly recommend.

I recently purchased and had a solar system installed by M Lia Electrics Pty Ltd, and the entire process surpassed my expectations. The pricing was competitive, transparent, and offered great value for money. Communication was excellent, with prompt and thorough responses at every stage. The team's availability to answer all my questions showcased their commitment to customer satisfaction. The installation was precise, professional, and the team left the site clean. I highly recommend M Lia Electrics for their fair pricing, exceptional communication, and dedication to customer satisfaction. Enjoying the benefits of clean, renewable energy—thanks to M Lia Electrics!
All facets of the work carried out to a very high standard.Have recommended Michael to my neighbors

Cannot fault the service.  Both Vanessa and Michael were professional and answered all questions.Michael provided great advice on solar systems and products.Great service and installation.Highly recommend M Lia electrics
They quoted almost immediately and was available for any concerns. The team were prompt, tidy and very friendly.  They organised the grid connection also.

Vanessa and Michael were a great team to deal with. Vanessa worked hard to get a reasonable quality system installed for our budget.End result was a neatly installed system that fits perfectly on the roof and was installed within the specified time. One of the best installed systems I have seen to date - great work.
A very stress-free process with a high quality installation from Michael. Any admin or procedural queries were readily handled or guided by Vanessa.
Very happy with M Lia Electrics. Can’t fault their professionalism, workmanship and customer service.

The company was very professional. Michael spent more time than he needed on site answering questions and was open and fair with the quote for the work he did. He was the only company to suggest putting the inverter in a place out of the weather (especially the sun) to extend its life. He quoted fairly for that work on the spot. The accounts process was quick and efficient and Vanessa was available when required. Michael explained the situation with our retailer and how to use the Fronius app, etc. Really good service and highly recommend this business.
Cannot fault M Lia Electrics. Michael & Vanessa made the whole process so easy. Michael's work was spot on, even to the point where the Electrical inspector said he does excellent work.

My experience with M Lia Electrics has been excellent from initial appointment, quoting, efficient installation and service to after care.Michael took the time to engage in phone conversations and explain the process and answer all my questions. Then he promptly came to my property to do the assessment and measurement to recommend best options for solar systems.Quoting was done greatly too, where M Lia electrics send numerous quotes 5-10 for different systems and inverters so that I can make the best informed decision looking at factors like value for money, quality and size.Installation was very quick and efficient and on time given the wet weather we had at the time.Michael has always been polite, knowledgeable and punctual throughout process and provided after sales care also.I would highly recommend M Lia Ekectrical.

I first looked into installing a solar system at my home a few years ago and I had a few concerns.1 After a detailed costing process I didn’t think it was financial buyable.2 Concerns with the appearance of the solar panels on my roof (the front of my property faces north) so all visitors would clearly see the panels.3 Concerns with the visibility of the rooftop DC isolators.Recently I revisited the whole going solar thing I wanted a system that would be installed where it was as pleasing to the eye as possible. I obtained two quotes and selected M Lia Electrics Pty Ltd. I felt comfortable dealing with the electrical installer Michael rather than a salesman. He detailed all the steps of the installation and the whole process. He stated that DC rooftop isolators are no longer required and with the new panels being 415 watts I only required 16 in total. Michael although a young feller has exceptional attention to detail. One of my original worries was the quality of installations that I've observed in my  local area. Ok they may meet standard but there's a lot to be said on the overall appearance. To support this Michael feed cabling from the meter box and inverter through the wall cavity so it looks as clean as possible. It really was pleasing so see someone take pride in what he or she does. With the assistance from Vanessa who processes all the paper work it really was a super easy experience and would highly recommend M M Lia Electrics Pty Ltd.
- well research system based on our needs- professional trades for install

I’d like to say that my interaction with M LIA Electrics was seamless, from onset to completion there were no issues, The Office kept us up to date and informed us with all the goings on, the actual fitting of  the Solar panels, tilt brackets, wiring and inverter set up is perfect, must say ‘Attention to detail’ and prompt and that’s the way it should always be, Thank you M LIA Electrics, appreciate your work.
